scope: Cross-system design audit; not a complete campaign playthrough

findings.issue: Final mission was followed by an optional mission and ordinary camp progression.
findings.resolution: Move S12 to day 23; settle day-24 main mission directly into endings. Day-23 camp is the final ordinary preparation window.

findings.issue: Advanced cooperation needs trust >=60, but meaningful cooperation rewards lacked a clear trust-independent entry path.
findings.resolution: Basic-action contributions to shared objectives or recorded promises can earn trust without an advanced protocol. Presence alone does not count; issue reward receipts from actual mission evidence.

findings.issue: Recovery economy is not fully defined: partial-outcome supply rewards, relief amount, temporary responder costs and last-resort shortfall resolution are missing.
findings.evidence: At 8 crew, upkeep is 5 supplies. Partial cash reward 12 buys 3 supplies; maximum support adds 1. If failure gives no supplies, this is still short before treatment. Failure supply rewards are currently unspecified, so this is a conditional counterexample, not a measured campaign failure rate.
findings.exit_criterion: Define outcome-by-outcome transfers and recovery alternatives; walk a low-resource, injured-roster state through at least two consecutive duty days without undocumented grants, negative inventory or an unavailable action.
findings.resolution: No daily food tax; explicit result rewards, free ordinary recovery, mission-scoped community responder terms and two-failure recovery trace. See campaign_economy_contract.json.

findings.issue: The per-squad conflict cap exists in data but the rule module only tracks each directional relationship independently. Multiple simultaneous conflicts and main-versus-side staffing/receipts lack an integrated scheduler.
findings.exit_criterion: Specify deterministic queue priority, persistent restrictions, opportunity costs and locks per phase; demonstrate two conflicting pairs plus a repeated side deployment without double rewards or double-booked actors.
findings.resolution: Deterministic conflict ordering, visible persistent restrictions, one extended interruption budget, phase-scoped assignments, atomic receipts and two evening projects. See campaign_coordination_contract.json.

findings.issue: Mission references and graph edges are valid, but district/evidence initial states and per-mission effects do not yet prove ending predicates or character-absence variants reachable.
findings.exit_criterion: Provide an authored state trace to each intended world ending, plus missing-character and missed-evidence traces; every required flag has an available producer.
findings.resolution: Initial districts, all 24 mission deltas, three evidence producers and fallback review windows, route preconditions before final commitment, all-failure coda. Concrete maps/text still require implementation and testing.

findings.issue: Fixed-team, rotation, equipment-first and relationship-investment strategies have not been compared in the combined game.
findings.exit_criterion: After complete rules integration, compare identical starting states and seeds, resource costs and outcomes; observe human play. Isolated relationship checks cannot establish this.
findings.resolution: Fixed and rotating rosters checked with fatigue, XP, supplies, purchases and camp budgets. Outcomes supplied as success; no optimality or win-rate claim.

findings.issue: Permanent-death preference remains undecided; current default is recoverable serious injury and signalled permanent departure.
findings.exit_criterion: Confirm before authoring permanent-loss character branches; technical design should represent presence/loss states without assuming all characters always exist.
findings.resolution: User: continue after mistakes; ordinary and standard recoverable injury; highest difficulty permits disclosed permanent departure; basic actions stay under player control.

production_readiness: Core cross-system contracts can guide implementation. Do not present the paper traces as a finished game, verified tactical feasibility or proof of player enjoyment.
revision_resolutions: 隐藏危险与完整预告
天气简报和开战后的危险预告免费公开；原扫描仪改为远程停机探针，付费收益为合法的远程1工量。
三套养成只加伤害
等级解锁办法，装备改变路线/工量，关系改变协作方式；基本攻击不随等级倍增。
为看故事挤掉全部恢复
短谈每晚两段免费；只有实质决定占项目；8条个人线的关键项目合计8个。
人物收束全挤在最后三天
调整第三段开放日并排出36段个人/重点关系的可用日历；不保证所有额外生活短谈一周目读完。
设备不开就无法救人、救不到人就缺技能
各关都有通用交互与停机开关；角色加入按主任务结算，不以成功为条件。
低信任无法合作就永远不涨信任
基础贡献也能产生守约凭据；只有高级协议需要双方60信任。
互相搬运刷信用和AP
同目标贡献去重；信任在任务结算发；所有协议支付双方AP，放下不触发奖励。
M17修复和隔离收益完全相同
隔离更近工量更少，但失去排水恢复并降低地区上限；修复保留完整设施潜力。
缺席人物仍在过场说话
明确临时伤势、永久医疗离队、战役后换职业三种状态；现场、来信、尾声分别处理。
证据原件与后期公共副本等价
早得事实可提前履约；晚核查仅补路线资格，不撤销已经违约或错过的人物选择。
工厂北侧资料被墙与两台机器封死
增加一个实际可走的侧门，路径检查覆盖所有任务对象，未用“默认有路”替代。
有工具但缺少合法目标
每关增加显式漏口，轻/重障碍与电源插口加类型，后期关卡加入灭火器开放后可用的火源。
学习协议被现场条件一并锁死
学习与使用分开；现场按动作标签、危险类型和实际保障判断。
关系破裂覆盖职业选择
职业去向与关系后记分开存储，避免一个结局标签包办所有后果。
